name: asc-mcp
description: Run an App Store release from a conversation: review status, reviews and sales, metadata, screenshots, builds, TestFlight, in-app purchases, submit and release. A local MCP server for App Store Connect plus a review-triage skill.

asc_issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
asc_issuer_id.description: The UUID from App Store Connect > Users and Access > Integrations > Keys

asc_private_key.title: API private key (.p8)
asc_private_key.description: Your AuthKey_XXXXXXXXXX.p8 from Apple. Leave empty if it is in ~/.appstoreconnect/private_keys. Read on this machine only, never transmitted.

asc_license_key.title: License key (optional)
asc_license_key.description: Leave empty for the free tier. A free 7-day trial is available by asking Claude, and needs your email address.
